description: Format a raw clinical demographics table in LibreOffice Writer to meet academic publication standards. Open /home/ga/Documents/draft_demographics.docx. 1) Create a multi-level header: Insert a new top row, merge cells to create 'Placebo (N=142)' spanning the Placebo Mean/SD columns, and 'Sarilumab (N=138)' spanning the Sarilumab Mean/SD columns. 2) Apply Decimal Tabs to all numerical data columns (Mean, SD, P-value) so values align on the decimal point. 3) Apply APA-style borders: Remove all vertical borders, add a thick (1.5pt+) line at the very top and bottom of the table, and a thin line under the header rows. Save the result as /home/ga/Documents/table1_final.docx.
